title: SSGC Announces Overnight Gas Shutdown in Karachi for Repairs
excerpt: Sui Southern Gas Company has scheduled an overnight gas shutdown on the Sher Shah mainline in Karachi to conduct urgent repair work.
body_html:
Sui Southern Gas Company (SSGC) has scheduled an overnight disruption in gas supply affecting Karachi. The interruption is necessary to facilitate essential maintenance and repair work on the 24-inch Sher Shah mainline.

Residents and local consumers in the impacted areas have been alerted regarding the temporary suspension of service while technical teams carry out the necessary pipeline improvements.
